title: Austin Approves School Parade Permit
summary:
*   Council greenlit a parade permit requested by Dawson Elementary School for their event on May 21st.
*   The special meeting was notably brief, lasting only five minutes, and focused solely on the parade permit decision.
*   A future work session was announced for May 21st at 5:00 PM.
